blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—With the next barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections moved to November 2028, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said it will use the extra time to strengthen its election security preparations. “We have more time to prepare, so let’s use it well. We can look at what worked, what needs to be improved, and what new concerns we need to prepare for,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Sunday. President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. signed Republic Act No. 12326 on Sept. 24, but disclosed its enactment only the following day, just three days before the […]...
